headline: This law extends a federal program to prevent and investigate child sexual exploitation online through fiscal year 2022.
what_it_does: It amends the PROTECT Our Children Act of 2008 to reauthorize the National Strategy for Child Exploitation Prevention and Interdiction. A reauthorization keeps an existing program running for a set period. This law sets that period through fiscal year 2022. The official summary does not describe the program's specific activities or funding amounts.

who_it_affects.group: Federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies that investigate child exploitation
who_it_affects.how: The program they work under is kept in place through fiscal year 2022.
The federal strategy aimed at preventing and investigating child exploitation continues during the extension period.

when_it_takes_effect: Took effect when it was signed into law on November 2, 2017.
